title.en: Thousands of Canadians call for US ambassador's expulsion
title.zh: 数千加拿大人呼吁驱逐美国大使

summary.en: An online petition accusing Pete Hoekstra of diplomatic interference in Canadian domestic affairs has garnered more than 60,000 signatures.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
More than 60,000 Canadians have signed a petition calling for the US ambassador in Ottawa to be expelled for undermining diplomatic relations between the two neighbours.

The online petition accuses Pete Hoekstra of "making repeated interventions in Canadian political discourse" and of having "normalised the Trump administration's threats to annex Canada as the '51st state'" of the US.

In a statement to the BBC, the US embassy said it was aware of the petition but declined to comment further.

Canada and the US are currently engaged in intense period of trade talks, aiming to reach an agreement before new US tariffs take effect next Wednesday.

The petition, launched by a woman in Calgary, also raises concerns about meetings in Washington between the US state department officials and some Albertans who want the province to separate from Canada.

It requests Ambassador Hoekstra be formally removed from his role, and a parliamentary committee review "U.S. diplomatic interference in Canadian domestic affairs".

A Republican and a Trump ally, Hoekstra has been a fierce defender of US President Donald Trump's trade policies, saying they are meant to secure the safety and prosperity of Americans.

There was a dust-up between Hoekstra and Ontario's trade representative , and the ambassador has been criticised for reposting Trump's comments about Canada becoming the 51st state and telling reporters it would be a "great discussion to be had" , external by the leaders of the two countries.

Most recently, he faced criticism for inviting one of the leaders of the 2022 Freedom Convoy movement to his official Fourth of July celebration.

He has also described some of the political rhetoric in Canada as "anti-American" and has frequently expressed frustration at the decision by most provinces to remove US alcohol from store shelves - a key point of friction in the current trade talks.

The petition for his recall will be tabled in parliament later this year by Green Party leader Elizabeth May.

In a statement to the BBC, May's office said that "she has an obligation to sponsor petitions brought forward by citizens, regardless of whether she personally agrees with what the petition is asking for".

The House of Commons allows for Canadians to submit petitions, and there are dozens open at any given time, many receiving just a few hundred signatures.

Once a petition, which must be submitted by a Canadian resident, is authorised by member of parliament, it is posted on parliament's website. If it reaches at least 500 valid signatures, it is then presented in the House and requires a government response.

The petition reached that bar as of Wednesday morning, garnering more than enough support to be presented in Canada's House of Commons.

title.en: Members of Trump's cabinet remained on decoy plane, after president's quiet exit
title.zh: 总统悄然离开后，其内阁成员仍留在诱饵飞机上

summary.en: During a Nato summit in Turkey, the president reportedly boarded a different plane to evade an Iranian threat, while members of his cabinet remained on a decoy plane.
summary.zh: 据报道，在土耳其举行的一次北约峰会期间，总统为躲避伊朗的威胁，登上了另一架飞机，而其内阁成员则留在了一架诱饵飞机上。

body.en:
Two members of US President Donald Trump's cabinet were on a decoy plane that Trump secretly exited before boarding a different flight in Turkey last month, CBS News reports.

Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent remained aboard what was believed to be Air Force One and didn't join a flight that was provided to Trump over security concerns involving Iran.

After Trump entered Air Force One on 8 July with both officials and members of the press, he hid on a catering truck to be clandestinely transported to a military plane.

The label "Air Force One" applies to any plane the president is on, but in this case the original craft kept the call signal, becoming a decoy.

According to CBS - the BBC's US partner - Rubio and Bessent remained on board the first aircraft to maintain the line of succession in case something happened to Trump.

In the event that the president dies or is incapacitated, Vice-President JD Vance would take power, followed by the Speaker of the House of Representatives and the President Pro Tempore of the Senate.

Others who stayed on the initial aircraft designated as Air Force One included White House Deputy Chief of Staff Stephen Miller and Steven Cheung, the White House's communications director.

The second aircraft that flew President Trump out of Ankara also included Pete Hegseth, the defence secretary, according to US media reports.

Speaking to reporters on Monday night, Trump said the decision to undertake the deception was made by the US military and the Secret Service, who "wanted me to go in a different flight".

The nature of the security threat remains unclear, with Trump providing no specifics, saying only that he gets "a lot of threats".

It is also unclear what the cabinet secretaries and other officials, along with the Air Force members working on the plane, knew of the operation. Members of the press have said they were not aware that they were on a decoy flight.

Various ruses, often referred to as "shell games" by Secret Service personnel, are common.

Identical versions of the president's heavily armoured limousine, for example, often switch positions in motorcades, as do helicopters transporting the president in the air.

More elaborate operations often take place during high-risk trips abroad, afnd in those cases reporters on Air Force One are typically briefed and asked not to report the movements in real-time.

In March 2000, for example, then-President Bill Clinton flew to the Pakistani capital of Islamabad on an unmarked executive jet that landed after a decoy jet with the livery of Air Force One.

Ahead of the trip, the White House informed USA Today reporter Susan Page - then the head of the White House Correspondent's Association - of the security arrangements.

verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: A huge AI datacenter is planned near Mar-a-Lago. The Everglades could pay the price
title.zh: 马阿拉歌附近计划建造大型人工智能数据中心，大沼泽地或将付出代价

summary.en: Plans for a massive AI datacenter in Palm Beach County, Florida, are raising environmental concerns due to its anticipated high demands for water and electricity, particularly given its proximity to the Everglades.
summary.zh: 佛罗里达州棕榈滩县计划建造一个大型人工智能数据中心，因其预计对水和电力的巨大需求，尤其考虑到其靠近大沼泽地，引发了对环境的担忧。

body.en: Plans for hyperscale datacenter in Palm Beach county prompt concerns over water and electricity demands About 16 miles (26km) west of the Mar-a-Lago estate on President Donald J Trump Highway, near the northern edge of the Florida Everglades, developers have proposed a hyperscale datacenter on a 202-acre (82-hectare) parcel of land surrounded by water. Local environmentalists warn that the proposed 600MW datacenter in western Palm Beach county could damage the wetlands, which the federal government and the state of Florida have spent a combined $6bn to restore after decades of drainage and development. One concern is that the datacenter could exacerbate an existing issue of toxic bacterial blooms in a water system which has already been stressed by drought, fertilizer runoff and warm water temperatures. In recent summers, the bright blooms of blue-green algae have covered nearly half of Lake Okeechobee, which feeds into the Everglades. Continue reading...
body.zh: 棕榈滩县超大规模数据中心计划引发了对水和电力需求的担忧在唐纳德·J·特朗普总统高速公路海湖庄园以西约 16 英里（26 公里）处，靠近佛罗里达大沼泽地北部边缘，开发商提议在一块 202 英亩（82 公顷）四面环水的土地上建设超大规模数据中心。当地环保人士警告称，拟议中的棕榈​​滩县西部 600 兆瓦数据中心可能会损害湿地。经过数十年的排水和开发，联邦政府和佛罗里达州已总共花费 60 亿美元来恢复湿地。一个担忧是，数据中心可能会加剧水系统中有毒细菌繁殖的现有问题，该系统已经受到干旱、化肥径流和水温的影响。最近夏天，蓝绿藻的鲜艳花朵覆盖了奥基乔比湖的近一半，该湖流入大沼泽地。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The proposed AI datacenter highlights the tension between technological advancement and environmental stewardship. As we develop new technologies, we are called to remember our role in tending and keeping the earth Yahweh has entrusted to us. This requires careful consideration of the long-term impact on natural resources and ecosystems.
reflection.zh: 拟建的人工智能数据中心凸显了技术进步与环境保护之间的张力。当我们开发新技术时，我们被呼召要记住我们受雅伟委托管理和看守大地的角色。这要求我们仔细考虑对自然资源和生态系统的长期影响。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
title.zh: 以色列定居者在约旦河西岸村庄围困巴勒斯坦家庭

summary.en: Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn from a West Bank village, leaving about a dozen settlers at the site where two Palestinian families have been besieged since Sunday.
summary.zh: 据报道，以色列安全部队已从约旦河西岸的一个村庄撤离，留下约十余名定居者在该地，自周日起，那里有两户巴勒斯坦家庭一直遭到围困。

body.en:
Israeli settlers have been besieging two Palestinian families in their homes in the occupied West Bank since Sunday, with the families saying their supplies were running out and rights groups urging the authorities to step in.

On Wednesday Israeli security forces were reported to have withdrawn from the Jewish settler outpost in the village of Qusra near Nablus, following clashes with a crowd of extremist settlers. About a dozen settlers are said to remain at the site.

After the Palestinian homeowners made their initial report to the Israeli army, the first soldiers who arrived at the scene were filmed praying with the settlers.

The Abu Ridi and Hassan families have been posting on social media appealing for help after their water and power supplies were cut off and their food stocks ran low.

It is not clear exactly what the settlers in Qusra want. In the past, settlers have forced Palestinians out of their homes and seized their properties.

The stated aim of the settlers is to empty the area of its Palestinian residents.

The latest developments come as a top UN official told the Security Council in New York on Tuesday that "the West Bank is at breaking point".

All settlements are illegal under international law. Outposts are set up without official Israeli authorisation.

Palestinian security camera footage shows settlers tearing down a wall outside the Abu Ridi family's home on Sunday evening and using the stones to block the road.

This left seven people - including two young girls – unable to leave their homes while other Palestinians could not reach them. They live in what is known as Area B, part of the West Bank under Palestinian administrative control and Israeli security control.

Posting on Facebook, Qusay Abu Ridi said the situation was critical, "especially as we are completely isolated".

He wrote: "We are living in our own home, on our own land, and we are asking for nothing more than the right to live safely and with dignity."

Aysha Hassan told Reuters the settlers had "tried to break the gate" to the house and "started throwing stones at us, cursing and insulting us".

On Monday, Israeli settlers blocked Israeli journalists from the left-leaning Haaretz newspaper from trying to reach the Palestinian properties. The reporters said Israeli soldiers at the scene refused to help them when their car was blocked for two hours. They were told the area was a closed military zone, however the order was not enforced on the settlers.

A day later the Israeli human rights group Yesh Din urgently appealed to the head of the Israeli military's Central Command for the army to protect the besieged residents, evacuate the settlers' outpost and hold the settlers accountable.

Late on Tuesday, a Palestinian ambulance was finally allowed to...
body.zh: 自周日以来，以色列定居者一直围攻被占领约旦河西岸的两个巴勒斯坦家庭，这些家庭表示他们的物资即将耗尽，人权组织敦促当局介入。 据报道，周三，在与一群极端主义定居者发生冲突后，以色列安全部队已从纳布卢斯附近库斯拉村的犹太定居者前哨撤出。据说大约有十几名定居者仍留在该地点。 在巴勒斯坦房主向以色列军队做出初步报告后，第一批到达现场的士兵被拍到与定居者一起祈祷。 阿布·里迪和哈桑一家在水电供应被切断、食品库存不足后，一直在社交媒体上发帖呼吁帮助。 最新事态发展发生之际，一名联合国高级官员周二在纽约向安理会表示，“约旦河西岸正处于崩溃边缘”。 根据国际法，所有定居点都是非法的。前哨基地的设立未经以色列官方授权。 巴勒斯坦安全摄像机的镜头显示，周日晚上，定居者推倒了阿布里迪家外的一堵墙，并用石头堵住了道路。 这导致七人——包括两名年轻女孩——无法离开家园，而其他巴勒斯坦人也无法联系到他们。他们居住在所谓的 B 区，是西岸的一部分，受巴勒斯坦行政控制和以色列安全控制。 库赛·阿布·里迪（Qusay Abu Ridi）在脸书上发帖称，情况危急，“尤其是在我们完全被孤立的情况下”。 他写道：“我们生活在自己的家中，生活在自己的土地上，我们所要求的只是安全和有尊严地生活的权利。” 周一，以色列定居者阻止左倾《国土报》的以色列记者试图进入巴勒斯坦人的财产。记者称，当他们的车被封锁两个小时时，现场的以色列士兵拒绝帮助他们。他们被告知该地区是军事禁区，但该命令并未对定居者执行。 一天后，以色列人权组织Yesh Din紧急呼吁以色列军方中央司令部负责人，要求军队保护被围困的居民，疏散定居者的前哨基地，并追究定居者的责任。 周二晚些时候，一辆巴勒斯坦救护车终于获准抵达这些家庭，运送食物并带走一名儿童接受治疗。 大约在同一时间，以色列国防军（IDF）发表声明，谴责建立新前哨基地。声明称，进入和占领巴勒斯坦人的房屋是“非法、应受谴责和不可接受的活动”。 当中央司令部司令阿维·布鲁斯少将和其他...

reflection.en: The news of families being besieged by settlers, with security forces withdrawn, highlights a grave imbalance of power and extreme vulnerability. Proverbs 28:15 reminds us how terrifying it is when those acting with unchecked aggression prey on helpless people. It calls us to lament for the vulnerable and pray for their protection from such tyranny.
reflection.zh: 报道称有家庭被定居者围困，而安全部队撤离，这突显了权力严重失衡和极度脆弱的局面。箴言28:15提醒我们，当那些肆意侵略的人欺压无助者时，是多么可怕。它呼吁我们为弱势群体哀叹，并祈求他们免受此类暴行的侵害。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: LA Lakers to be sold in record $12.5bn deal
title.zh: 洛杉矶湖人队以创纪录的125亿美元出售

summary.en: The Los Angeles Lakers is to be sold for a reported record $12.5bn - less than a year after Mark Walter took a majority stake in the NBA franchise.
summary.zh: 据报道，洛杉矶湖人队将以创纪录的125亿美元出售，这距离马克·沃尔特获得这支NBA球队的多数股权还不到一年。

body.en:
The Los Angeles Lakers are to be sold for a reported record-breaking $12.5bn , external (£9.3bn) - less than a year after Mark Walter took a majority stake in the NBA franchise.

Josh Kushner, the brother of US President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared, and former Disney chief executive Bob Iger are buying the controlling interest in one of the world's most iconic sports teams.

Walter bought his share, reportedly worth an estimated $10bn (£7.45bn) - a previous record - from the Buss family in a deal that was unanimously approved by the NBA Board of Governors in October 2025.

Kushner and Iger said in a statement: "As lifelong NBA fans, we are deeply honoured for the opportunity to become stewards of the Los Angeles Lakers, one of the most iconic sports franchises in the world.

"We have immense respect for the leadership and vision of Jerry and Jeanie Buss.

"Our long-term commitment is to build on that foundation, compete at the highest level, and serve this extraordinary team, its fans, and the city of Los Angeles."

Jerry Buss bought the Lakers in a $67.5m deal (£50m) in 1979 that included the Los Angeles Kings hockey team and a Los Angeles arena, known as the Kia Forum.

After he died in 2013, ownership was passed to his six children in a Trust before a deal was completed with Walter, who also owns a stake in the LA Dodgers with Todd Boehly.

"Owning the Los Angeles Lakers has been one of the great honors of my life," said Walter.

"It has been an extraordinary investment, but what I will carry with me is the community, the fans, and a city that treats this team as family.

"I am grateful to Jeanie Buss, the Buss family, the players, and the staff for welcoming me into this chapter. The Lakers belong to Los Angeles, and I have every confidence the best is still ahead."

The LA Lakers have 17 NBA titles - one less than the record of 18 held by the Boston Celtics.

The deal involving Kushner comes after he was part of the recent controversy surrounding Fifa president Gianni Infantino and an aborted plan to sell off stakes in the governing body's competitions to private investors.

Thrive Eternal, an American venture capital firm founded by Kushner, was expected to lead the proposed investor group for the Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal.
body.zh: 据报道，洛杉矶湖人队将以破纪录的 125 亿美元（93 亿英镑）出售，距离马克·沃尔特 (Mark Walter) 持有 NBA 球队多数股权还不到一年。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的女婿贾里德的弟弟乔什·库什纳和迪士尼前首席执行官鲍勃·艾格正在购买世界上最具标志性的运动队之一的控股权。 据报道，沃尔特从巴斯家族手中购买了价值约 100 亿美元（74.5 亿英镑）的股份，创下了之前的纪录，这笔交易于 2025 年 10 月获得了 NBA 理事会的一致批准。 库什纳和艾格在一份声明中表示：“作为终生的 NBA 球迷，我们非常荣幸有机会成为世界上最具标志性的体育球队之一洛杉矶湖人队的管理者。 “我们非常尊重杰里·巴斯和珍妮·巴斯的领导力和远见。 “我们的长期承诺是在此基础上继续发展，在最高水平上竞争，并为这支非凡的球队、球迷和洛杉矶市服务。” 1979 年，杰里·巴斯 (Jerry Buss) 以 6,750 万美元（5,000 万英镑）的价格收购了湖人队，其中包括洛杉矶国王曲棍球队和洛杉矶竞技场（称为 Kia Forum）。 2013 年他去世后，所有权转移给了他在信托基金中的六个孩子，之后与沃尔特完成了一项交易，沃尔特还与托德·博利 (Todd Boehly) 共同拥有洛杉矶道奇队的股份。 “拥有洛杉矶湖人队是我一生中最伟大的荣誉之一，”沃尔特说。 “这是一项非凡的投资，但我将随身携带的是社区、球迷和一座将这支球队视为家人的城市。 “我感谢珍妮·巴斯、巴斯家族、球员和工作人员欢迎我进入这一章。湖人队属于洛杉矶，我完全有信心最好的球队仍在前面。” 洛杉矶湖人队共获得 17 个 NBA 冠军，比波士顿凯尔特人队保持的 18 个 NBA 冠军纪录少了一个。 涉及库什纳的交易是在库什纳卷入最近围绕国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺的争议以及向私人投资者出售国际足联赛事股份的计划流产之后达成的。 库什纳创立的美国风险投资公司 Thrive Eternal 预计将领导 FIFA Forward Enterprise（FFE）提案的拟议投资者小组。

reflection.en: The record-breaking sale of the LA Lakers highlights the immense value placed on earthly achievements and institutions. While striving for excellence in any field is commendable, this reminds us that all earthly crowns are perishable. Yahweh invites us to pursue an imperishable prize, found in eternal values and His kingdom.
reflection.zh: 洛杉矶湖人队以创纪录的价格出售，凸显了世人对世俗成就和机构的巨大价值。虽然在任何领域追求卓越都值得称赞，但这提醒我们，所有世俗的冠冕都是会朽坏的。雅伟邀请我们去追求那永不朽坏的奖赏，这奖赏存在于永恒的价值和祂的国度里。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Mozart tribute ends on sour note after mass figurine theft
title.zh: 大规模雕像失窃后，莫扎特致敬以酸涩结束

summary.en: A playful tribute to Mozart has turned into a whodunit after 210 gold-colored figures disappeared from one of Austria's busiest tourist spots. The mass theft forced organizers to end the outdoor display early.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A playful tribute to Mozart has turned into a whodunit after 210 gold-colored figures disappeared from one of Austria's busiest tourist spots. The mass theft forced organizers to end the outdoor display early.

More than 200 gold-colored Mozart figures have vanished from a public art installation in Salzburg, forcing organizers to end part of the exhibition early.

The theft has disrupted a major public art project marking the 270th anniversary of composer Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's birth in his home city.

The Mozarteum Foundation said 210 of the 320 figures installed in the city's Mirabell Garden had disappeared. The theft forced organizers to end the garden display early.

Organizers had kept some replacements in reserve, but not enough to offset the scale of the theft.

The manufacturer is also on summer holiday, leaving no quick way to replace them.

Several dozen figures remain on display at the Mozarteum and Mozart 's birthplace until the end of August.

The figures had been placed in the Mirabell Garden and at several Mozart-related sites around Austria's fourth-largest city.

The polymer figures show Mozart with his dog Pimperl, a nod to the composer's everyday life in Salzburg.

German conceptual artist Ottmar Hörl, who is behind the display, said he wanted to show Mozart not as a monument but "as a normal human being despite his genius."

Hörl is known for installations made up of large numbers of identical figures depicting famous personalities.

Hörl said he did not believe tourists had simply walked off with the 50-centimeter (20-inch) figures.

"This is organized theft," he said, suggesting they were probably taken at night after the garden had closed. "I find it a bit cheeky."

Hörl had planned to sell the figures after the exhibition for around €90 each, putting the loss at roughly €20,000.

A previous Hörl display in Bayreuth suffered a similar fate when 100 figures of composer Richard Wagner disappeared.

"That's just the nature of public space," Hörl said. "When you work as an artist in a public space, you mustn't complain about what is happening there. It ranges from destruction to theft. That’s just how it is."

body.zh: 210 个金色雕像从奥地利最繁忙的旅游景点之一消失后，一部向莫扎特致敬的俏皮电影变成了一部侦探小说。大规模盗窃事件迫使组织者提前结束户外展示。 超过 200 个金色莫​​扎特雕像从萨尔茨堡的公共艺术装置中消失，迫使组织者提前结束部分展览。 这起盗窃事件扰乱了其家乡纪念作曲家沃尔夫冈·阿玛多伊斯·莫扎特诞辰 270 周年的大型公共艺术项目。 莫扎特基金会表示，安装在该市米拉贝尔花园的 320 个雕像中，有 210 个失踪了。这起盗窃事件迫使组织者提前结束花园展示。 组织者保留了一些替代品，但不足以抵消盗窃的规模。 制造商也正在放暑假，没有办法快速更换。 直到八月底，莫扎特博物馆和莫扎特的出生地仍展出数十尊雕像。 这些雕像被放置在米拉贝尔花园和奥地利第四大城市周围的几个与莫扎特相关的地点。 聚合物人物展示了莫扎特和他的狗 Pimperl，向作曲家在萨尔茨堡的日常生活致敬。 展览背后的德国概念艺术家奥特马尔·霍尔表示，他不想把莫扎特展示为一座纪念碑，而是“作为一个普通人，尽管他有天才”。 霍尔以由大量描绘名人的相同人物组成的装置而闻名。 霍尔表示，他不相信游客会直接带着这些 50 厘米（20 英寸）的人物走开。 “这是有组织的盗窃行为，”他说，并暗示这些物品可能是在夜间花园关闭后被偷走的。 “我觉得有点厚脸皮。” 霍尔原计划在展览结束后以每件 90 欧元左右的价格出售这些人物模型，这样一来损失就达到了约 20,000 欧元。 之前在拜罗伊特举行的 Hörl 展览也遭遇了类似的命运，作曲家理查德·瓦格纳 (Richard Wagner) 的 100 个雕像消失了。 “这就是公共空间的本质，”霍尔说。 “当你作为一名艺术家在公共场所工作时，你不能抱怨那里发生的事情。它的范围从破坏到盗窃。事情就是这样。” 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Eritrea: An emerging key player in the geopolitical gamble at the Horn
title.zh: 厄立特里亚：非洲之角地缘政治赌博中新兴的关键参与者

summary.en: Amid growing tensions and security risks at the Horn of Africa, Eritrea, with its strategically important coastal points on the Red Sea and a perceived lack of conflict, is emerging as important player in the region.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Amid growing tensions and security risks at the Horn of Africa, Eritrea, with its strategically important coastal points on the Red Sea and a perceived lack of conflict, is emerging as important player in the region.

Across the Horn of Africa , geopolitical interests of various countries continue to cause tensions and conflict as part of the growing competition for political influence over the region.

In its own right, the small country of   Eritrea  appears to be gaining in importance within this context: The autocratic state run by long-standing ruler  Isaias Afewerki  controls strategically important coastal points on the Red Sea, especially with its ports of Assab and Massawa.

In July, a series of diplomatic consultations in Cairo involving regional powers like Egypt,  Somalia , Eritrea, and a high-ranking US envoy highlighted Eritrea's growing role in helping to coordinate approaches to resolving serious security challenges in the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea, and to facilitate trade.

Eritrea's unique location along this maritime route is notably becoming more and more strategic in light of international trade conflicts; after all, the small nation's coastline near the Bab-al-Mandab Strait stretches for more than 1,000 kilometers, bordering Sudan to the northwest and Djibouti to its southeast.

But Eritrea's main strategic importance relies on who is on the other side of the strait, which at its narrowest point measures fess than 30 kilometers.

"Yemen lies on the other side of the Red Sea , which makes Eritrea's location particularly interesting, as Yemen is in a state of crisis and maritime security in the region is at risk," Abdurahman Sayed, director of the Horn of Africa Centre for Regional Integration (CRI) in London, told DW.

"The only safe route in this area runs through Eritrea, where there are currently no security concerns."

The Houthi terrorist militia , propped up by Iran, have been attacking merchant ships in the Red Sea from the Yemeni coastline.

For the past ten years,  Yemen has also been witnessing one of the world' sworst humanitarian crises in its midst: Ongoing violence, economic collapse, droughts and floods have exacerbated the suffering in the country, according to a report published by the UN Refugee Agency last month.

Sayed meanwhile also emphasizes that in Eritrea, the strong dictatorship entrenched for decades does not tolerate any type of dissent; in fact, in many international freedom indeces, the African nation often only comes second to North Korea.

body.zh: 在非洲之角的紧张局势和安全风险日益加剧的情况下，厄立特里亚正在成为该地区的重要参与者，该国在红海沿岸具有重要的战略意义，而且被认为缺乏冲突。 在整个非洲之角，各国的地缘政治利益继续引发紧张局势和冲突，这是该地区政治影响力竞争日益激烈的一部分。 就其本身而言，厄立特里亚这个小国似乎在这种背景下变得越来越重要：由长期统治者伊萨亚斯·阿费沃尔基领导的独裁国家控制着红海具有重要战略意义的沿海点，特别是其阿萨布和马萨瓦港口。 7 月，埃及、索马里、厄立特里亚等地区大国和美国高级特使在开罗举行了一系列外交磋商，突显了厄立特里亚在帮助协调解决非洲之角和红海严重安全挑战以及促进贸易方面发挥的日益重要的作用。 鉴于国际贸易冲突，厄立特里亚在这条海上航线上的独特地理位置变得越来越具有战略意义；毕竟，这个小国靠近曼德海峡的海岸线绵延 1000 多公里，西北与苏丹接壤，东南与吉布提接壤。 但厄立特里亚的主要战略重要性取决于谁在海峡的另一边，该海峡最窄处的长度不到 30 公里。 伦敦非洲之角区域一体化中心（CRI）主任阿卜杜拉赫曼·赛义德（Abdurahman Sayed）告诉德国之声：“也门位于红海的另一边，这使得厄立特里亚的地理位置特别有趣，因为也门正处于危机状态，该地区的海上安全也受到威胁。” “该地区唯一安全的路线穿过厄立特里亚，目前那里没有安全问题。” 在伊朗的支持下，胡塞恐怖民兵一直从也门海岸线袭击红海的商船。 联合国难民署上个月发布的一份报告显示，过去十年来，也门也经历了世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一：持续的暴力、经济崩溃、干旱和洪水加剧了该国的苦难。 赛义德同时还强调，在厄立特里亚，几十年来根深蒂固的强大独裁政权不容忍任何类型的异议；事实上，在许多国际自由度方面，非洲国家往往仅次于朝鲜。 自该国正式成立32年来，这个一党制国家从未举行过选举……

title.en: Italy: Etna eruption in Sicily halts Catania flights
title.zh: 意大利：西西里岛埃特纳火山喷发导致卡塔尼亚航班暂停

summary.en: Sicily's Catania airport has suspended flights again as Mount Etna continues to spew lava and volcanic ash. The eruption has disrupted travel during the peak summer holiday season.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.zh: 由于埃特纳火山继续喷出熔岩和火山灰，西西里岛卡塔尼亚机场再次暂停航班。火山喷发扰乱了夏季假期高峰期间的旅行。 西西里岛卡塔尼亚机场周三暂停航班，直至下午 4 点以上。当地时间周四（1400 GMT/UTC），响应埃特纳火山的新火山灰排放。 火山灰可能对飞机构成危险，因此迫使监管机构限制进入西西里岛东部周围的空域，从而扰乱了夏季假期高峰期。 机场运营商 SAC 表示：“建议乘客向航空公司查询航班状态。” “进一步的更新将在接下来的几个小时内进行。” 自上周五以来，旅行中断对西西里岛东部造成了尤其严重的影响，当时欧洲最活跃的火山再次发出隆隆声，风向变化，开始将火山灰带入该地区。随着火山喷发的持续，直到最近几天，领空才完全关闭。 在度假者最繁忙的季节之一，卡塔尼亚（位于西西里岛东海岸，埃特纳火山以南）的长期限制给西西里岛的其他机场带来了额外的压力。 巴勒莫市市长罗伯托·拉加拉 (Roberto Lagalla) 表示，该市机场最近几天已接待了约 190 架原定降落在该岛东部的航班。 意大利安莎通讯社周三还报道称，卡塔尼亚南部较小的枢纽科米索机场在周二晚间暂停交通后，正在恢复航班。 一些火山灰也向南漂过地中海，流向马耳他，据报道航班出现严重延误和部分航班取消。周三，马耳他国际机场继续警告乘客可能出现的航班中断，但表示情况正在改善。 埃特纳火山是西西里岛东海岸一座约 3,400 米（约 11,100 英尺）的成层火山。它的精确高度不断变化，特别是在活动频繁的时期，它可能会下降几米。 它是欧洲最高的活火山之一，也是意大利阿尔卑斯山以南的最高峰。 它几乎一直处于低水平活动状态，并且相当频繁地以更明显的方式爆发。近年来，它已多次造成卡塔尼亚机场的混乱。 埃特纳火山被联合国教科文组织列为世界遗产，大约 50 万年前发生了第一次火山活动。 罗马和希腊神话都声称，铁匠之神——无论是火神还是赫菲斯托斯——在埃特纳火山下都有他的锻造厂。 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

title.en: US inflation eases as food and fuel costs cool
title.zh: 美国通胀缓解，食品和燃料成本下降

summary.en: Annual US inflation dipped to 3.4% in July, with food costs slowing and housing keeping prices slightly higher.
summary.zh: 美国7月份的年通货膨胀率降至3.4%，主要原因是食品成本放缓，但住房价格仍使整体物价略高。

body.en:
US prices rose 3.4% in the year to July, slightly lower than the 3.5% in the year to June, new figures show.

Energy remained volatile as the Middle East conflict has continued. While gasoline prices were down 2.9% in July compared to June, they were up 24.6% over the year.

Month to month, inflation rose 0.1%, mainly due to an increase in housing costs, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said. Even small moves in rent can lift the overall headline figure as it makes up a large share of household spending.

Food prices rose only slightly in July and at a slower rate than in June, while energy prices fell, offering some relief for consumers.

While inflation was slightly lower in July compared to June, that means prices are rising at a slower pace, not that prices overall are falling.

Prices excluding food and energy rose 0.2% after staying flat in June, with medical care and airline tickets edging higher and car insurance continuing to fall.

The new Federal Reserve chair, Kevin Warsh, has said the central bank's priority is to "keep inflation moving down" while avoiding unnecessary shocks to the economy.

In a recent press briefing, Warsh said the Fed cannot use a "magic wand" to undo years of above-target inflation and must stay patient as price growth cools gradually.

One of the Fed's key jobs is to keep inflation near 2%, a level policymakers say keeps prices stable, supports steady economic growth, and helps prevent deeper downturns.

President Donald Trump has also said inflation is still too high for many families, pointing to rent and grocery bills as signs that the cost of living remains a major concern.

Financial markets reacted calmly to the latest figures, with stocks little changed as the figures were broadly in line with market expectations.

Recent labour market concerns have also softened expectations for a rate increase, after July's report showed a loss of jobs .
body.zh: 新数据显示，截至 7 月的一年中，美国物价上涨 3.4%，略低于截至 6 月的一年中的 3.5%。 随着中东冲突的持续，能源依然波动。虽然 7 月汽油价格较 6 月下降 2.9%，但全年上涨 24.6%。 美国劳工统计局表示，通货膨胀率环比上涨 0.1%，主要是由于住房成本增加。即使租金的小幅波动也能提升总体数据，因为租金占家庭支出的很大一部分。 7 月食品价格仅小幅上涨，且涨幅较 6 月放缓，而能源价格下跌，为消费者带来了一定的缓解。 虽然 7 月份的通胀率略低于 6 月份，但这意味着价格上涨速度较慢，而不是价格整体下跌。 不包括食品和能源的价格在 6 月份持平后上涨 0.2%，医疗保健和机票小幅上涨，汽车保险继续下跌。 新任美联储主席凯文·沃什表示，央行的首要任务是“保持通胀下降”，同时避免对经济造成不必要的冲击。 沃什在最近的新闻发布会上表示，美联储无法使用“魔杖”来扭转多年来高于目标的通胀，必须在物价增长逐渐降温的情况下保持耐心。 美联储的一项关键工作是将通胀率保持在 2% 左右，政策制定者表示，这一水平可以保持物价稳定，支持经济稳定增长，并有助于防止经济进一步下滑。 唐纳德·特朗普总统还表示，对于许多家庭来说，通货膨胀仍然过高，并指出租金和食品杂货账单表明生活成本仍然是一个主要问题。 金融市场对最新数据反应平静，股市几乎没有变化，因为数据基本符合市场预期。 在 7 月份的报告显示就业岗位流失之后，近期劳动力市场的担忧也削弱了加息的预期。

reflection.en: The easing of inflation, particularly in food and fuel costs, brings welcome relief to many households. This reminds us to consider the ultimate source of our economic well-being and provision. Yahweh gives us the ability to produce wealth and sustains the conditions that allow for stability and flourishing.
reflection.zh: 通货膨胀的缓解，尤其是食品和燃料成本的下降，给许多家庭带来了可喜的宽慰。这提醒我们思考经济福祉和供应的最终来源。雅伟赐予我们创造财富的能力，并维持着使稳定和繁荣得以存在的条件。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Gulf states scramble for Strait of Hormuz alternative
title.zh: 海湾国家争相寻找霍尔木兹海峡替代方案

summary.en: Saudi Arabia has diverted some oil exports from the Strait of Hormuz, a crucial global energy choke point. However, most other Gulf producers still lack dependable alternative routes, prompting a scramble for solutions to mitigate risks associated with the strait's vulnerability.
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯已将部分石油出口从全球重要的能源咽喉要道霍尔木兹海峡改道。然而，大多数其他海湾产油国仍缺乏可靠的替代路线，这促使它们争相寻找解决方案，以减轻该海峡脆弱性带来的风险。

body.en:
Saudi Arabia has redirected oil exports away from the Strait of Hormuz, but most Gulf producers still lack a reliable backup option to the world's most important energy choke point.

Months of blockades and uncertainty around the Strait of Hormuz have pushed energy exporters to look for ways to bypass the key shipping lane.

Iranian officials had insisted the waterway would remain closed and negotiations would not resume unless the United States complied with a June framework agreement and offered compensation to Tehran for alleged violations.

US President Donald Trump, however, said on Monday that the US Navy already controls the Strait of Hormuz .

The narrow waterway between Iran and Oman is one of the world's most critical oil shipping routes. Before the Iran war , it carried around 20% of global crude exports from the Persian Gulf to markets in Europe, Asia and North America.

Facing the prolonged disruption, however, Saudi Arabia  has demonstrated that it can redirect substantial volumes away from the Strait of Hormuz. The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has had less success, despite possessing ports and pipelines specifically designed for that purpose.

The US-Iran war has placed greater importance on alternative shipping lanes through the Red Sea .

Saudi Arabia is sending its crude through the East-West Pipeline from the kingdom's eastern oil fields to the Saudi Red Sea port of Yanbu, enabling it to keep up shipments to global markets by circumventing Hormuz entirely.

During April and May, Saudi cargo shipments from its Gulf coast fell from 47.5 million tons a year earlier to just 6.3 million tons, according to data from the International Monetary Fund's Portwatch platform.

Over the same period, exports through the Red Sea rose from 29.6 million to 54.8 million tons. That additional 25.2 million tons replaced roughly 61% of the volume lost on the Persian Gulf side.

The shift shows that the East-West Pipeline is not merely an emergency backup, but also an important tool to keep Saudi oil flowing during a Hormuz closure.

The Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen recently declared a maritime blockade on Saudi Arabia, but its impact was not immediately clear.

While Saudi Arabia is working to remove bottlenecks in its East-West system, its eastern neighbor UAE is looking at adding parallel capacity alongside its Abu Dhabi Crude Oil Pipeline (ADCOP).

On paper, the UAE is well prepared. ADCOP carries crude from Habshan in Abu Dhabi to Fujairah on the Gulf of Oman, outside Hormuz. Fujairah and nearby Khor Fakkan also provide major deepwater facilities on the eastern coast.

title.en: New Zealand PM Chris Luxon survived a leadership fight, but a greater challenge lies ahead
title.zh: 新西兰总理克里斯·卢克森(Chris Luxon)在领导权之争中幸存下来，但更大的挑战还在后面

summary.en: A series of recent gaffes has put Luxon's leadership under a microscope as his government prepares to face the music.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Chris Luxon will box on as New Zealand prime minister after winning a caucus confidence vote, defying doubters in and outside his party after a run of gaffes that imperilled his premiership.

The National leader called a crunch meeting of his partyroom for Wednesday morning to end speculation around his future.

A leadership change looked on after NZ Herald reported growing dissatisfaction with Luxon's performance, three months out from the 7 November election.

Instead, Luxon emerged victorious from the lengthy meeting, claiming to have united the party and pledging to win a second term for his conservative coalition.

"There was a confidence vote in my leadership this morning at our caucus meeting, and I have the full support of our caucus," he said, in a 75-second appearance without taking questions.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Luxon's office later revealed low-profile defence minister Chris Penk challenged for the leadership in the meeting.

The prime minister then sacked him for doing so, leaving Penk to announce his intention to leave politics at the November election.

Wednesday's vote followed a similar caucus showdown in April, when Luxon brought on and won a confidence vote to silence his critics.

The margin of each vote is a tightly held secret, though media outlets have reported the April result was 27-22 in Luxon's favour.

Rather than Penk, Wellington newspaper The Post reported Erica Stanford, the education minister, was the most likely challenger.

The 48-year-old never confirmed this, and was served a brutal backhander by colleague Nicola Grigg, the minister for women, on the way to the meeting.

One political editor described Luxon's leadership as "hanging by a thread" on Tuesday night, and another rated his survival as "incredibly unlikely", making his victory a defiant and triumphant moment for Luxon.

title.en: Time running out in Colombia quake search as rescuers cling to signs of hope

summary.en: The death toll from Monday's earthquake in Colombia continues to climb, as emergency rescue teams work tirelessly to locate survivors trapped beneath the debris.

body.en:
The search for life in the rubble of Colombia’s powerful earthquake grew more desperate on Wednesday as search teams pushed up against a key time threshold to locate survivors with signs of life.

The devastation has tested Colombia’s new President Abelardo de la Espriella and his government as it scrambles to respond to the natural disaster and civil society as it pushes to provide aid to the vulnerable communities most affected by the quake.

By Tuesday, de la Espriella said the 7.4 magnitude earthquake had killed at least 181 people and left 2,595 more injured in the west of the country. He said at least 195 remained missing, but civilian-run databases put that number closer to 4,000.

Teams continued to pick through the rubble overnight in the hardest-hit cities of Cali, Pereira, Manizales and Quibdo, as time ticked away for victims to be found — and rescued — alive.

Aid agencies consider the first 48 to 72 hours crucial for retrieving survivors, though that threshold can be extended if they have access to food and water.

Small successes have broken through the flattened buildings: rescuers pulling a dust-covered baby through a crack in a concrete wall and onlookers cheering as teams lift a woman onto a stretcher.

In many areas, the official response to the devastation has been complicated by the ongoing crises of deep poverty and civil warfare that have forced displacement for decades.

“This earthquake compounds an already severe humanitarian situation, and there is a need for increased support for the humanitarian response,” said Giovanni Rizzo, Colombia director for the Norwegian Refugee Council.

A 2016 peace accord between rebels and the government, along with an ongoing armed conflict, may allow aid organisations to distribute food and other emergency materials more quickly, said María José Torres, the U.N. resident coordinator in Colombia. Aid organisations are already in place in some conflict-torn centres because of the peace process, including Choco at the epicentre of the quake.

“We have a presence on the ground. Therefore, our ability to be there, present with the people, I think, has increased exponentially,” Torres said in a statement Wednesday.

At the same time, aid from other countries and nonprofits abroad continued to roll in.

The US has offered over US$15 million in aid, and Mexico’s president said she is prepared to send hundreds of search and health workers, tons of health supplies and other equipment.

title.en: Former Syrian president Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia for war crimes
title.zh: 叙利亚前总统巴沙尔·阿萨德因战争罪被缺席判处死刑

summary.en: Al-Assad has been sentenced over his actions during Syria's nearly 14-year civil war — but he's unlikely to face execution.

body.en:
A Syrian court has sentenced ousted Syrian president Bashar al-Assad and his younger brother to death in absentia for crimes against humanity and war crimes during Syria's nearly 14-year conflict that left about half a million people dead.

The sentences at the Fourth Criminal Court in Damascus are the first against al-Assad or members of his inner circle since the family's five decades in power came to an end 20 months ago .

"Bashar Assad used state agencies to commit war crimes and crimes against humanity," judge Fakhareddine al-Aryan said during a court session that was aired live on state TV on Tuesday.

Al-Assad and his brother Maher fled to Russia after the government's fall in December 2024 and received political asylum. Syria's new rulers have asked Russia to hand the Assads over.

Also sentenced to death was al-Assad's maternal cousin Atef Najib, who was convicted of overseeing a crackdown in the southern province of Daraa that led to the uprising and later the civil war.

Al-Aryan said Najib — who did not flee to Russia and has been detained in Syria since early 2025 — can appeal.

Under tight security, Najib stood in a cage, wearing a prisoner's uniform, as the judge read the sentence.

A crowd gathered outside the courthouse in central Damascus to hear the verdict.

"Today is the day of justice for all the wounded, martyrs, detainees and Syrians who were forced to leave their country," lawyer Adnan al-Masalmeh, who represented families of Najib's victims, said.

"Today marks a victory of right against injustice, a victory of the Syrian people against the ousted regime."

Najib, who was sanctioned by the US Department of the Treasury in April 2011, is one of the highest-ranking security officials to be put on trial.

Najib is a former army brigadier general who was head of the Political Security Branch in Syria's southern Daraa province under al-Assad in 2011.

During his tenure, more than a dozen teenagers who scrawled anti-government graffiti on a school wall in Daraa were arrested and tortured.

The case became a catalyst for mass protests against the repressive policies of al-Assad's security forces.

The protests were met by a brutal government crackdown that spiralled into a 14-year civil war that ended with al-Assad's removal in a lightning rebel offensive.

Maher al-Assad was a former commander of the Syrian military's 4th Armoured Division — which opposition activists have accused of killings, torture, extortion and drug trafficking, as well as running its own detention centres.

"Today's scenes outside the courthouse reflect 15 years of pain and a justice long denied....

title.en: Fifteen dead, 27 missing as ferry capsizes in Zimbabwe
title.zh: 津巴布韦渡轮倾覆 15人死亡27人失踪

summary.en: More than 114 passengers were onboard the ferry when it tipped. But only 77 were rescued and taken to shore.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
An overloaded ferry has capsized on Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba, killing at least 15 people, with 27 still missing.

Seventy-seven people were rescued and taken to an island on the lake, the national disaster management agency said.

But the statement by Zimbabwe's Civil Protection Unit added that it could only confirm there were 114 adult passengers on board, along with five crew members, based on confirmed ticket sales.

There could have been an unknown number of children below ticketing age who were on board and not accounted for, it said.

Mutsa Murombedzi, a local member of parliament, posted a video of what she said were people on shore waving off what appeared to be the ageing ferry at the start of its journey.

She said rural communities use the boat to travel along the lake to the town of Kariba.

Some people standing on the shore were also concerned about whether the ferry would survive strong waves on the lake, according to the video.

Earlier, Zimbabwe police said a rescue operation was underway but provided no further details.

Zimbabwean state broadcaster ZBC published video of speedboats approaching what appeared to be an overturned boat on the lake as a helicopter hovered overhead.

Lake Kariba in southern Africa forms part of the border between Zimbabwe and its neighbour Zambia.

It is the largest man-made lake in the world by volume and was created in the late 1950s and early 1960s by building a dam wall to block the Zambezi River — resulting in a valley slowly filling with water to form a huge lake that's now more than 200km long and up to 40km wide in places.

title.en: Zhu Rongji, who helped turn China into a trading giant, dies at 97
title.zh: 曾帮助中国成为贸易大国的朱镕基去世，享年97岁

summary.en: The former premier brought China into the WTO and championed reforms that fuelled growth.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Former Chinese Premier Zhu Rongji, who spearheaded China's entry into global trade and laid the foundation for its explosive growth, has died at the age of 97.

He served in the country's second-highest office from 1998-2003 and played a leading role in securing its entry into the World Trade Organization, opening Chinese factories to the international market and drawing foreign investment.

He was one of the most important economic reformers who moved local tax powers to the central government, closed or privatised failing state firms and promoted home ownership.

Many in China remember him as a tough and pragmatic leader who delivered double-digit growth and was rarely afraid to speak his mind.

In 1998, he said China was facing "many potential crises that could erupt at any time...

"Ordinary people are discontent about us in many ways. Especially, there is corruption among officials, the gulf between rich and poor and the way some local officials act like tyrants."

He labelled rogue bankers as "half-wits" and said the dams and flood dykes lining the Yangtze River were as "flimsy and porous as tofu dregs".

Under his leadership, which helped stabilise the economy and tackle corruption, China began transforming into a manufacturing powerhouse, leaving behind its status as a Communist outsider.

Though he faced criticism because those reforms also led to 30 million lay-offs over five years, and with huge growth came more inequality.

Chinese state media describe Zhu Rongji's life as one of "revolution, struggle and brilliance".

He was born in the central province of Hunan in 1928 and earned a degree in electrical engineering before joining the civil service.

He joined the Communist Party in 1949, but was purged twice - first after criticising Mao Zedong's economic policies as "irrational" and being labelled a "rightist", and again during the Cultural Revolution.

Zhu was brought back into the fold after Mao's death, and by 1991 had risen to the role of vice-premier in charge of China's economy.

Zhu led China through difficult negotiations to enter the World Trade Organization in 2002.

In state media his obituary described him as an "outstanding member of the Communist Party of China and loyal Commnist fighter... an outstanding leader of the Party and state".
body.zh: 中国前总理朱镕基去世，享年97岁。朱镕基是中国进入全球贸易的带头人，为中国的爆炸性增长奠定了基础。 1998年至2003年，他在中国第二高职位任职，在确保中国加入世界贸易组织、中国工厂向国际市场开放和吸引外国投资方面发挥了主导作用。 他是最重要的经济改革家之一，他将地方税收权力移交给中央政府，关闭或私有化破产的国有企业，并促进住房所有权。 许多中国人都记得他是一位强硬而务实的领导人，实现了两位数的增长，并且从不害怕说出自己的想法。 1998年，他表示中国面临“许多随时可能爆发的潜在危机…… “普通人在很多方面对我们不满。特别是官员腐败、贫富差距和一些地方官员的暴君行为。” 他将流氓银行家称为“笨蛋”，并称长江沿岸的水坝和防洪堤“像豆腐渣一样脆弱、多孔”。 在他的领导下，中国稳定了经济并解决了腐败问题，开始转变为制造业强国，摆脱了共产主义局外人的地位。 但他也面临批评，因为这些改革也导致五年内 3000 万人失业，而且巨大的增长带来了更多的不平等。 中国官方媒体将朱镕基的一生描述为“革命、奋斗、辉煌”的一生。 他 1928 年出生于中部湖南省，在加入公务员队伍之前获得了电气工程学位。 他于1949年加入共产党，但两次遭到清洗——第一次是在批评毛泽东的经济政策“非理性”并被贴上“右派”标签之后，第二次是在文化大革命期间。 毛泽东去世后，朱重回国门，并于 1991 年升任副总理，主管中国经济。 2002年，朱镕基带领中国通过艰难的谈判加入世界贸易组织。 官方媒体的讣告将他描述为“优秀的中国共产党党员、忠诚的共产主义战士……党和国家的杰出领导人”。

title.en: Floods, storms and landslides: Typhoon Dolphin ravages China – in pictures
title.zh: 洪水、风暴和山体滑坡：“海豚”台风肆虐中国——图集

summary.en: Typhoon Dolphin, the most powerful tropical cyclone to hit China this year, has caused widespread damage along the country's east coast. It brought strong winds, torrential rain, and severe flooding, with Beijing bracing for a significant portion of its annual rainfall in a single day.
summary.zh: 今年袭击中国的最强热带气旋“海豚”台风给中国东海岸带来了大风、暴雨和洪水，造成了广泛破坏。北京正准备迎接其年降雨量三分之一的雨水在24小时内降临。

reflection.en: The immense power of Typhoon Dolphin reminds us of creation's vulnerability and the deep impact natural forces can have on human lives and infrastructure. In moments when the earth itself seems to groan under the weight of storms, we are called to acknowledge the broader suffering of creation.
reflection.zh: “海豚”台风的巨大威力提醒我们，受造界是脆弱的，自然力量能对人类生活和基础设施造成深远影响。当地球本身似乎在风暴的重压下呻吟时，我们被呼召去认识到受造界更广泛的苦难。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Cook Islands election: PM Mark Brown speaks on the diplomatic crises that defined his year

body.en: The prime minister tells the Guardian that last year’s diplomatic rift with ally New Zealand could be on voters’ minds as they head to the polls As voters in the Cook Islands prepare to head to the polls in a high-stakes general election, they will have much to reflect on. Over recent years, politics in this small island nation has been defined by fierce debates about deep-sea mining , diplomatic rifts with ally New Zealand and a major reshaping of the country’s foreign partnerships. In an exclusive interview with the Guardian, days before Wednesday’s poll, Cook Islands prime minister Mark Brown defended his four-year term and the decisions he made that have seen this South Pacific nation of 17,000 people pushed into the international limelight, turning it into a battleground for influence between Beijing and western powers . Continue reading...
body.zh: 总理告诉《卫报》，去年与盟友新西兰的外交分歧可能会成为选民在前往投票站时考虑的问题。当库克群岛的选民准备在一场高风险的大选中投票时，他们将有很多事情需要反思。近年来，这个小岛国的政治一直围绕深海采矿、与盟友新西兰的外交分歧以及该国对外伙伴关系的重大重塑展开激烈辩论。在周三投票前几天，库克群岛总理马克·布朗在接受《卫报》独家采访时为他的四年任期和他做出的决定进行了辩护，这些决定使这个拥有 17,000 人口的南太平洋国家成为国际关注的焦点，使其成为北京与西方列强之间争夺影响力的战场。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Diplomatic rifts between nations, even allies, can weigh heavily on public sentiment and political decisions. Romans 12:18 reminds us of the enduring call to live peaceably with all, as far as it depends on us. This principle encourages leaders and citizens alike to seek reconciliation and maintain harmonious relationships, even amidst past tensions.
reflection.zh: 国家之间，即使是盟友，外交上的裂痕也会严重影响公众情绪和政治决策。罗马书12:18提醒我们，要尽力与众人和睦相处，这是持久的呼召。这一原则鼓励领导人和公民在过去的紧张局势中，仍要寻求和解并维持和谐关系。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: The China factor in the United States' $500 million move in a tiny Australian town
title.zh: 美国在澳大利亚小镇投资5亿美元的“中国因素”

summary.en: The Pentagon is investing $500 million in a small Australian town in New South Wales, a move attributed to strategic considerations related to China. The reason for this sudden interest in a town of only 130 people is its role in broader international geopolitical dynamics.
summary.zh: 五角大楼正在澳大利亚新南威尔士州的一个小镇投资5亿美元，此举被认为是与中国相关的战略考量。这个只有130人的小镇突然受到关注，是因为它在全球地缘政治动态中的作用。

body.en:
The town of Fifield near Parkes is about a six-hour drive west of Sydney, and at the last Census was home to about 130 people. Now, the town has found itself at the centre of a major strategic play by the United States government.

The US Department of War has committed to make a conditional loan of US$400 million (about $566 million) to Sunrise Energy Metals, an Australian mining company hoping to deliver the world’s first supply of a key critical mineral outside of China.

Scandium is listed as a critical mineral in both Australia and the US, signalling its strategic importance in aerospace and defence.

This loan is another chapter in the US government’s search for secure critical mineral supply chains to reduce its dependency on Chinese supply. But success will require sustained investment and government support.

Scandium is a highly strategic metal used to produce ultra-high-strength alloys needed for the most advanced fighter jets. It is also used in solid oxide fuel cells, crucial for providing reliable power to artificial intelligence (AI) data centres.

First, demand for scandium is being driven by massive increases in defence spending across North America, Europe and Asia and an investment boom in power-hungry AI data centres.

Second, China’s sweeping export controls on rare earth elements, including scandium, have contributed to a persistent shortage of supply on the global market, pushing up prices.

These export controls are designed to maintain China’s dominance of supply chains for key critical minerals and slow down the US defence and industrial base.

Still, the market for scandium is tiny. According to statistics from the US Geological Survey, the entire world only consumed 60 tonnes of the metal in 2025.

Scandium is usually found in very small quantities. For that reason, until now, it has been exclusively produced as a byproduct of nickel and titanium processing.

This is what sets the Sunrise Energy Metals project apart — the proposed mine has scandium deposits in a high enough concentration to be the first primary source of scandium in the world.

If production goes ahead, and lives up to its promise of producing 60 tonnes of high-purity scandium each year by 2028, this would be enough to completely satisfy the current level of global demand.

According to the company, there is also potential to expand the project in the future and add another 120 tonnes of production.

The deal gives the US government first rights to purchase scandium from Sunrise Energy Metals, with production expected to start in late 2028.

title.en: Worldview 'gulf' behind strained Australia-China ties, former Australian ambassador says
title.zh: 前澳大利亚大使称，世界观“鸿沟”是澳中关系紧张的幕后原因

summary.en: Australia's former ambassador to China identified "diverging worldviews" as a key obstacle to fostering a robust relationship between the two nations.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚前驻华大使指出，“世界观差异”是澳中两国建立健康关系的主要障碍之一。

body.en:
Australia is unlikely ever to have a true partnership with China due to a mismatch of worldviews, rendering it pointless to pursue that goal, the nation's former top diplomat to China says.

But in an analysis piece for the Lowy Institute, Australia's former ambassador to China Graham Fletcher noted several wildcards, such as Chinese military action in Taiwan , could still disrupt the "modest new normal" of the relationship.

The change in government at the 2022 federal election acted as a circuit-breaker in increasingly fraught dealings between the nations, although they had still been marred by intimidatory military encounters involving Chinese forces, he said.

China sparked widespread international condemnation over its launch of a ballistic missile into the South Pacific in July following the signing of a landmark mutual defence alliance between Australia and Fiji.

The Albanese government sought to stabilise relations with China after diplomatic tensions peaked during the COVID-19 pandemic under then-prime minister Scott Morrison's leadership.

China slapped $20 billion in trade sanctions on Australian exports, measures that have slowly been wound back.

China is Australia's largest trading partner and is the destination for about a third of the nation's exports.

Fletcher said China had not given up hope of drawing Australia closer into its orbit, while Australia was more focused on consolidating its current relationship.

"But this relationship is unlikely ever to become genuinely close — like the relaxed, intimate fellowship Australia enjoys with like-minded partners elsewhere in its region and beyond," he said.

"The gulf in terms of diverging world views and national security agendas is simply too wide.

"It would be pointless for Canberra to pursue such a goal; it recognises this and is realistic."

The "mismatch" of world views made the relationship vulnerable to disruption, with key risks including another round of serious disagreements or the cataclysm of a conflict, including the use of force against Taiwan.

"An upheaval or conflict is always a possibility, though not in my opinion a strong one at present," the former diplomat said.

Australia would be on firmer ground when facing China if policies had cross-party support and politicians did not "seek to exploit difficulties for domestic advantage", Fletcher said.

"Bipartisanship produces policy consistency and limits China's ability to play games within the Australian system," he said.

Fletcher was Australia's ambassador to China from 2019 to 2023 and led the negotiating team in 2014 that helped seal a free trade agreement between the two...
body.zh: 澳大利亚前驻华最高外交官表示，由于世界观不匹配，澳大利亚不太可能与中国建立真正的伙伴关系，因此追求这一目标毫无意义。 但澳大利亚前驻华大使格雷厄姆·弗莱彻在洛伊研究所的一篇分析文章中指出，一些不确定因素，例如中国在台湾的军事行动，仍然可能破坏两国关系的“适度新常态”。 他说，2022 年联邦选举中的政府更迭为两国之间日益令人担忧的交易起到了断路器的作用，尽管它们仍然受到涉及中国军队的恐吓性军事冲突的损害。 在澳大利亚和斐济签署具有里程碑意义的共同防御联盟后，中国于 7 月向南太平洋发射弹道导弹，引发了国际社会的广泛谴责。 在时任总理斯科特·莫里森 (Scott Morrison) 的领导下，新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 疫情期间外交紧张局势达到顶峰后，阿尔巴尼亚政府寻求稳定与中国的关系。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 中国对澳大利亚出口产品实施了价值 200 亿美元的贸易制裁，但这些措施已慢慢取消。 中国是澳大利亚最大的贸易伙伴，也是该国约三分之一出口的目的地。 弗莱彻表示，中国并未放弃将澳大利亚拉近其轨道的希望，而澳大利亚则更专注于巩固当前的关系。 “但这种关系不太可能变得真正亲密——就像澳大利亚与其地区及其他地方志同道合的伙伴所享有的轻松、亲密的友谊一样，”他说。 “世界观和国家安全议程的分歧实在太大了。 “堪培拉追求这样的目标是毫无意义的；它认识到这一点并且是现实的。” 世界观的“不匹配”使得两国关系容易受到破坏，其主要风险包括新一轮严重分歧或爆发冲突，包括对台湾使用武力。 这位前外交官表示：“动乱或冲突总是有可能发生，尽管我认为目前可能性不大。” 弗莱彻表示，如果政策得到跨党派支持，并且政客们不“寻求利用困难谋取国内利益”，那么澳大利亚在面对中国时将会更加坚定。 “两党合作带来了政策的一致性，并限制了中国在澳大利亚体系内玩弄游戏的能力，”他说。 弗莱彻于 2019 年至 2023 年担任澳大利亚驻中国大使，并于 2014 年领导谈判团队，帮助两国签署了自由贸易协定……

title.en: More than one million evacuated, flights cancelled, as Typhoon Dolphin hits China
title.zh: 台风“海豚”袭击中国，逾百万人撤离，航班取消

summary.en: Typhoon Dolphin has led to the evacuation of over one million people and the cancellation of flights in China. The cyclone previously swept across Japan, causing injuries to six people and cutting power to more than 50,000 buildings.
summary.zh: 台风“海豚”袭击中国，导致逾百万人撤离，航班取消。此前，该气旋已横扫日本，造成六人受伤，并导致超过五万栋建筑断电。

body.en:
Typhoon Dolphin brought heavy rain to eastern China on Monday, causing hundreds of flight cancellations even as the storm weakened and some cities resumed public transport.

The typhoon had already swept across Japan’s southern Okinawa prefecture, injuring six people and cutting power to more than 50,000 buildings.

It then made landfall near Yuhuan in eastern Zhejiang province on Sunday evening, China's meteorological authorities said.

The storm packed maximum sustained winds of 151km/h near its centre at landfall, equivalent to a Category 1 hurricane on the Saffir-Simpson scale.

Authorities had moved offshore workers to safety, ordered vessels back to port and increased checks at reservoirs, mountain streams, landslide-prone areas, construction sites and tourist locations.

The weather system lost power after making landfall, with China's National Meteorological Centre (NMC) issuing its least severe typhoon alert on Monday morning.

However, the NMC warned that parts of east and central China would continue to receive heavy rain for the next day.

The typhoon had triggered a top-level alert over the weekend, prompting over 1,000 flight cancellations and tens of thousands of evacuations.

Transport was widely disrupted across the east of the country, and more than one million people were evacuated from their homes.

Nine hundred and forty-three flights from Shanghai's two main passenger airports were cancelled, the airport authority said in an online post.

A 42-year-old tourist from Guangdong said he was stranded in Shanghai after his family's flight, scheduled to depart on Sunday, was cancelled due to Typhoon Dolphin.

He said the family had been rebooked on a flight at 10pm on Monday, although they were unsure whether it would be able to take off.

"To us Guangdong people, this typhoon is as ordinary as having a meal and feeling the wind. It's just part of everyday life," he said, adding that the storm did not appear particularly strong by the standards of China's southern coast.

In neighbouring Zhejiang province, the city of Wenzhou relocated more than 900,000 residents and opened more than 1,000 emergency shelters.

In Fujian province, authorities evacuated 98,900 people from high-risk areas after raising the typhoon emergency response to Level 3, according to Xinhua. Zhejiang, Shanghai and Jiangsu have also activated Level 3 emergency responses.

Fujian maritime authorities said 55 coastal passenger ferry routes had been suspended, all 115 offshore construction projects had been halted, and 290 construction vessels had been moved to sheltered waters.

title.en: New twist in Australia's bird flu battle amid 'extinction-level impact' warning
title.zh: 澳大利亚禽流感之战出现“灭绝级别影响”警告的新转折

summary.en: Scientists have also said there are limits to how many wild animals can be protected through vaccination.

body.en:
Scientists have warned that Australia's H5N1 outbreak could take a new turn if the virus mixes with local bird flu strains.

CSIRO scientists analysing bird flu virus samples are watching for signs the deadly H5N1 strain has swapped genetic material with influenza viruses already circulating in Australian birds.

The process could produce new strains capable of infecting a broader range of bird species, though scientists stress this has not yet been detected in Australia and the potential impacts of any new strain cannot be predicted.

They have also warned the virus could have an "extinction-level impact" on some of Australia's most vulnerable species, while acknowledging there are limits to how many wild animals can be protected through vaccination.

When different influenza strains infect the same host, those segments can be exchanged through a process known as reassortment, creating a virus with a new combination of genes.

CSIRO senior research scientist Dr Frank Wong said this process had occurred as H5N1 spread around the world, with the virus picking up genetic material from local bird flu viruses.

"When a virus goes to a new area and it picks up gene segments from local viruses, it could provide the new genotype or new strain with better host fitness for host species in that new area," he said.

That could mean the virus becomes better suited to infecting new bird species or a broader range of birds.

Wong said reassortment could occur in Australia, which is why scientists are continuing to track the virus, but its potential impact would be difficult to predict.

CSIRO's Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness is using whole genome sequencing to monitor the virus and identify changes as more samples are collected.

Sequencing team leader Dr Matthew Nieve said scientists were specifically looking for signs the H5N1 virus introduced to Australia, known as genotype B3.2, had "switched up one of its genes with a local low path Australian virus".

Scientists are also looking for mutations that could indicate changes in the virus which allow it to infect mammals more readily.

So far, sequencing suggests the virus has entered mainland Australia multiple times, with CSIRO detecting at least six or seven separate introduction events believed to have originated from Heard Island, which is about 4,100km south-west of Perth.

Nieve said that figure was likely an underestimate because it only included incursions that had been detected and sampled.

But the sequencing shows a different pattern among some Australian resident birds.

Working full-time hours in retail and hospitality while undertaking her degree, she said she has been forced to return to her Brisbane family home while she tries to save a deposit to eventually buy a property.

But rising everyday costs mean saving is difficult, leaving her feeling as though the traditional path into adulthood is becoming increasingly out of reach.

"I feel like I'm doing everything you're told you're supposed to do. I'm working, I'm studying, I'm saving when I can," she told SBS News.

Sophie's experience reflects a broader trend identified in a new five-year analysis of the Australian Youth Barometer.

The Monash Centre for Youth Policy and Education Practice has tracked more than 2,700 Australians aged 18 to 24 since 2021, examining their experiences across work, education, housing, wellbeing, relationships and civic participation.

Its latest report describes young Australians as living through a "polycrisis" of overlapping economic, social, environmental and political pressures that compound one another.

Affordable housing was the biggest issue young people flagged as needing urgent action, rising from 60 per cent in 2022 to 82 per cent in 2025.

Also recognised as needing urgent action was employment opportunities, which rose from 48 in 2022 to 64 per cent in 2025. Climate change was identified as an issue needing urgent action by 44 per cent in 2025, falling from 47 per cent in 2022.

Monash University professor Lucas Walsh, the report's lead author, says the significance of the findings is in how those issues connect.

"These are all embedded within the idea of a polycrisis, which involves overlapping independent events in crisis that intersect and amplify each other," he told SBS News.

Walsh said the study started tracking young Australians at the height of the COVID-19 pandemic, providing a five-year window into how their lives and priorities have changed as the country moved through and beyond it.

He describes the pandemic as a "flash of light into more persistent problems" which exposed pressures that were already disproportionately affecting young people.

"I don't necessarily expect to own a house tomorrow, but I would like to feel like it's something I could realistically work towards. It can be discouraging to feel like the goalposts for how much I need to have saved, how much I need to be earning or even spending to get a home keeps changing," she said.

Wendy Stone, a professor of housing and social policy at Swinburne University, told SBS News that secure housing provides the foundation that young people need to establish independence, work, study and relationships.

title.en: A new era for Australia's gig workers? The changes coming for delivery drivers
title.zh: 澳大利亚零工工人新时代？送货司机将迎来哪些变化

summary.en: Australia is set to introduce new regulations for gig workers, including delivery drivers, marking a significant shift in how these workers are classified and compensated. The changes aim to provide greater protections and clarify employment conditions for those in the gig economy.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚将为包括送货司机在内的零工工人引入新规定，这标志着这些工人分类和报酬方式的重大转变。这些变化旨在为零工经济中的弱势群体提供更大的保护，并明确其雇佣条件。

body.en:
The Fair Work Commission has issued a new minimum standards order for gig workers, including on-demand food, beverage and grocery delivery drivers.

The standards, released on Tuesday, stipulate that on-demand delivery workers must be paid a minimum rate of $31.30 or up to $32 per hour, depending on the type of vehicle used. The order also specifies that delivery platforms must insure workers for on-the-job injuries.

The Transport Workers' Union (TWU), which represents Australian gig workers, said these changes have been years in the making . The TWU initially applied for the minimum standards order in 2024, alongside food delivery platforms Uber Eats and DoorDash.

In a joint statement provided to SBS News, TWU national secretary Michael Kaine described the new standards as "world-leading".

"The world is looking on as gig workers in Australia win new rights and protections that will change their lives, after years of campaigning for a better industry," Kaine said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Employment and Workplace Relations Minister Amanda Rishworth also believes the order is a "big step" in providing more robust worker protections .

She said it means "food and delivery workers don't have to trade off flexibility for fairer protections".

The TWU said "hundreds of thousands" of delivery workers in Australia will be impacted by the new orders.

They specifically apply to employee-like workers who are engaged through digital on-demand delivery platforms — such as Uber Eats and DoorDash — and mainly deliver consumables (food, beverages or liquor) or supermarket groceries .

These workers will be entitled to a guaranteed minimum hourly rate for their "engaged time" between accepting an order and completing the delivery. This is also called an "earnings floor".

People operating bicycles or e-bikes will be paid $31.30 an hour. For motorbikes, this increases to $31.80 per hour, and workers driving cars will earn $32 per hour.

According to the interim order, platforms will calculate a worker's total earnings over a period of up to 21 days. If a worker "has been paid less than the earnings floor in an earnings period, the digital labour platform operator will pay a top-up amount to ... make up the difference", it said.

title.en: Opposition to promise migration cuts as frontbencher refuses to confirm figure

summary.en: The opposition's housing spokesperson, Andrew Bragg, is set to unveil a new housing and migration policy, which includes proposed migration cuts, during an address at the National Press Club.
summary.zh: 反对党住房事务发言人安德鲁·布拉格将在国家新闻俱乐部发表演讲，推广一项新的住房和移民政策，其中包括提议削减移民人数。

body.en:
A senior Coalition frontbencher has refused to confirm specifics of his party's plan to cut migration numbers, despite a formal announcement expected to be made later on Wednesday.

Opposition housing spokesperson Andrew Bragg will use a major speech at the National Press Club on Wednesday to call for a cut to net overseas migration levels by nearly half to meet the rate of new housing supply being built.

Treasury modelling published in the May budget expects net overseas migration to fall from 301,000 to 225,000 by the end of this decade.

But the Opposition frontbencher will advocate for an average annual net overseas migration rate of 180,000 to make up for a housing shortfall.

"A [net overseas migration] reduction on this scale is manageable and in line with reductions we have managed in recent history," Bragg will say.

"Lifting migration standards, and analysing them carefully each year, is crucial to ensure integrity and public trust in our migration settings."

But his colleague, Opposition treasury spokesperson Tim Wilson, backed away from confirming the number just hours before the speech.

Wilson was pressed on the topic during a News24 interview, in which he said: "I don't think you should bank that at all (the 180,000 figure). Let's just wait and see, firstly, what Senator Bragg's saying in his speech".

"We haven't made an announcement about where we're going to be going into the next election, but our focus is actually about what we need to do to invest in the long-term growth and success of our country," he said.

The centrepiece of Bragg's speech will be a commitment to replace the National Construction Code with a new 80-page "Basic Australian Standard".

The codes set minimum requirements for the safety, health, amenity, accessibility, and sustainability of certain buildings, as detailed in over 2,000 pages.

The Coalition's new standards will focus on cost-effective structural, fire safety and health-related building standards.

"Anything else like mandatory ramps, flattened shower flooring or reinforced walls would be optional extras," Bragg will say.

Labor announced it would freeze the National Construction Code following its productivity roundtable in mid-2026.

Housing Minister Clare O'Neil brushed off calls from the Coalition to cut the construction standards to 200 pages earlier in 2026.

"I've talked to builders about that, they laugh their heads off. That is absolutely ridiculous," O'Neil told the National Press Club in May.

The government is not far off presenting a final plan to the building minister later this year to streamline the code, Treasurer Jim Chalmers told ABC Radio...

body.en:
On Tuesday, many Australians arrived at the airport with their plane waiting on the tarmac and clear skies overhead — only to discover their flight had been delayed.

Around 200 flights moving through Melbourne and Perth Airports were forecast to experience delays, according to a daily plan issued by Airservices Australia.

In Sydney, 138 flights were expected to be impacted by ground delays of around 43 minutes, in part due to strong winds, the government-owned air traffic management organisation said.

Rob Sharp, CEO of Airservices Australia, acknowledged that flight delays and disruptions can cause "very high frustration levels" for passengers, airlines and airport partners alike.

Behind the scenes, delays are often used to ensure public safety is not compromised during what Sharp described as a "challenging period" for air traffic controllers.

"We do this through effectively putting space between aircraft. But it does come at a cost, and that cost is delays," Sharp said during a press conference on Monday.

His comments follow significant delays to flights on Friday and Saturday last week. On Sunday, two passenger jets also narrowly avoided a ground collision at Sydney Airport, with the incident now under investigation.

It's left industry leaders and aviation experts questioning whether Australia's air traffic control workforce can keep up with aviation demands.

Uğur Turhan is a senior lecturer in aviation at the University of New South Wales in Canberra. He said controllers are responsible for air traffic safety and efficiency , both on the ground and in the air.

"You cannot put somebody as a high-performing air-traffic controller in one day or one year ... generally, we think that five years' experience is a really good level to perform at high levels in complex traffic situations," Turhan told SBS News.

There are three types of controllers — tower controllers, terminal controllers and en route controllers — responsible for various stages of flights including take-off, landing and airspace movement.

While training programs vary, typically air traffic controllers train for 12 months before undergoing additional on-the-job training.

Australian air services manage more than 51 million square kilometres of airspace, equivalent to approximately 11 per cent of the world's airspace. This area is managed 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, Airservices Australia said.

Federal Transport Minister Catherine King believes the work of air traffic controllers is a "really stressful and difficult job".
